value.rationale: A complete classification for two natural subgroup orbit types, at all \(n\ge3\) and all positive layers, reveals arbitrarily high-dimensional geometric fixed spheres for transitive actions that become contractible for point stabilizers. These subgroup fixed-space maps contain equivariant topological information not encoded by ambient Betti numbers or \(S_n\) character formulas. The general orbit lemma and path recurrence are known techniques, but the sharp contrast and uniformly contractible two-orbit locus for this canonical graph family are mathematically motivated.
